validation.limitMustBeNumber: Budget limit must be a number

calendarAligned.label: Align to calendar cycle
calendarAligned.description: Reset budgets at the start of each period (e.g. 1st of month) instead of rolling from creation date. Quarterly budgets always align to fiscal quarter starts.

toasts.cannotRemoveConfig: You can't remove network configuration for this provider.
toasts.baseUrlRequired: Base URL is required for this provider.

streamIdleTimeout.label: Stream Idle Timeout (seconds)
streamIdleTimeout.description: {{time}} Max time to wait for next chunk before closing a stalled stream

maxConnsPerHost.label: Max Connections Per Host
maxConnsPerHost.description: Max TCP connections per provider host. For HTTP/2 providers (e.g. Bedrock), each connection supports ~100 concurrent streams.

keepAliveTimeout.label: Keep-Alive Timeout (seconds)
keepAliveTimeout.description: {{time}} Idle keep-alive for pooled connections. Set below the upstream server's keep-alive to avoid reusing connections it has already closed.

enforceHttp2.label: Enforce HTTP/2
enforceHttp2.description: Force HTTP/2 on provider connections. Relevant for net/http-based providers (e.g. Bedrock) where each HTTP/2 connection supports ~100 concurrent streams.

allowPrivateNetwork.label: Allow Private Network
allowPrivateNetwork.description: Allow connections to private IPs (e.g. 10.x, 192.168.x). Required for providers on a LAN, k8s pod network, or private VPC. Cloud metadata addresses (169.254.x.x) are always blocked.

skipVerification.label: Skip TLS verification
skipVerification.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for provider connections. This bypasses server certificate validation and should be used only as a last resort when a trusted CA chain cannot be configured. Prefer ca_cert_pem for self-signed or private CA deployments.

caCert.label: CA Certificate (PEM) (Optional)
caCert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust for provider endpoint connections (e.g. self-signed or internal CA).

state.noChangesWithErrors: No changes made and validation errors present

proxy.scopeNote: Applies to HTTP requests and WebSocket-based Realtime/Responses connections. WebRTC-based Realtime sessions use a separate media path not covered by this proxy.

caCert.label: CA Certificate (PEM) (Optional)
caCert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust for TLS connections through SSL-intercepting proxies. You can also use env.YOUR_PROXY_CA_CERT_VAR.

rawRequest.label: Send Back Raw Request
rawRequest.description: Include the raw provider request alongside the parsed request in the API response.

rawResponse.label: Send Back Raw Response
rawResponse.description: Include the raw provider response alongside the parsed response in the API response.

storeRaw.label: Store Raw Request/Response
storeRaw.description: Persist raw request and response payloads in log records.

baseProviderType.label: Base Provider Type
baseProviderType.description: The underlying provider this custom provider will use

isKeyless.label: Is Keyless?
isKeyless.description: Whether the custom provider requires a key

disableStore.label: Disable Store
disableStore.description: With the Responses API, store defaults to true, and when it is on, the generated response is stored for later retrieval via API. OpenAI exposes endpoints to retrieve and delete stored responses, so your response IDs become durable server-side objects instead of one-shot IDs.

betaHeaders.intro: Configure which Anthropic beta headers are allowed for this provider. Override the defaults when a provider adds or removes support for a beta feature.
betaHeaders.addPrefixPlaceholder: Add custom beta header prefix (e.g. new-feature-)

errors.knownHeader: This is a known header; use the override dropdown above instead
errors.invalidCharacters: Prefix must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens

toasts.updateFailed: Failed to update beta header configuration

allowedRequests.title: Allowed Request Types
allowedRequests.description: Select which request types this custom provider can handle.
allowedRequests.descriptionHint: Click the settings icon to customize endpoint paths or use full URLs.

customPath.title: Custom Path or URL
customPath.description: Override with a path (e.g., /v1/chat) or a full URL (e.g., https://api.example.com/chat) to bypass base_url

customProvider.title: Add Custom Provider
customProvider.description: Enter the details of your custom provider.

allowPrivateNetwork.label: Allow Private Network
allowPrivateNetwork.description: Allow connecting to private network IPs (e.g. 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x). Link-local addresses remain blocked.

isKeyless.label: Is Keyless?
isKeyless.description: Whether the custom provider requires a key

deleteProvider.title: Delete Provider
deleteProvider.description: Are you sure you want to delete this provider? This action cannot be undone.

confirmRedirection.title: Confirm Redirection
confirmRedirection.description: You have unsaved data. Are you sure you want to continue?

keyForm.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to modify provider keys

weight.label: Weight
weight.tooltip: Determines traffic distribution between keys. Higher weights receive more requests. Not used when adaptive load balancing is enabled - key selection is then based on live performance.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.geminiOnly: API Key (Supported only for gemini and fine-tuned models)

allowedModels.label: Allowed Models
allowedModels.tooltip: Select specific models this key applies to, or choose "Allow All Models" to allow all. Leave empty to deny all. Aliases must be added by their alias name - listing only the underlying model does not allow the alias (an alias best-model → gpt-4o requires "best-model" here, not just "gpt-4o").

blockedModels.label: Blocked Models
blockedModels.tooltip: Models this key must never serve. The denylist always wins - if a model appears in both Allowed Models and here, it is blocked. Select "All Models" to block every model on this key. Aliases are matched by their alias name - blocking only the underlying model does not block aliases that point to it.

deployments.label: Deployments (Optional)
deployments.description: Map a request model name to the provider's identifier (deployment name, inference profile ID, fine-tuned endpoint ID, etc.). Expand a row to set the canonical model name, model family, and provider-specific overrides - these power cost/pricing logs and family-based routing.

azure.defaultCredentialNote: Uses DefaultAzureCredential - automatically detects managed identity on Azure VMs and containers, workload identity in AKS, environment variables, and Azure CLI. No credentials required.

scopes.label: Scopes (Optional)
scopes.tooltip: Optional OAuth scopes for token requests. By default we use https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/.default - add additional scopes here if your setup requires extra permissions.

vertex.attachedNote: Uses the service account attached to your environment (GCE, GKE, Cloud Run). No credentials required.

projectNumber.label: Project Number (Required only for fine-tuned models)

region.label: Region (Required)
region.description: Multi-region-only models are automatically routed to Google's matching multi-region endpoint. Turn on <1>Force single region</1> below to always use exactly this region.

authCredentials.label: Auth Credentials (Required)
authCredentials.description: Service account JSON object or env.VAR_NAME
authCredentials.storedSecurely: Credentials are stored securely. Edit to update.

forceSingleRegion.label: Force single region
forceSingleRegion.description: Always call the region set above and skip automatic promotion of multi-region-only models to a multi-region endpoint. Enable when serving these models from a single region via provisioned throughput.

useDeploymentsEndpoint.label: Use Deployments Endpoint
useDeploymentsEndpoint.description: Route requests through the Replicate deployments endpoint instead of the models endpoint.

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the vLLM server (e.g. http://vllm-server:8000 or env.VLLM_URL)

modelName.label: Model Name (Required)
modelName.description: Exact model name served on this vLLM instance

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the {{provider}} server (e.g. {{url}} or {{envVar}})

anthropicEndpoints.label: Use Anthropic Endpoints
anthropicEndpoints.description: Routes chat completions and responses requests through Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

credentials.iamNote: Uses IAM roles attached to your environment (EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS).
credentials.apiKeyNote: Uses a Bearer token for API key authentication.
credentials.mantleApiKeyNote: Uses a Bedrock Mantle API key sent as a Bearer token.

mantleProjectId.label: Mantle Project ID (Optional)
mantleProjectId.description: Scopes Bedrock Mantle-routed models (OpenAI-family / Gemma) to a specific project via the OpenAI-Project header. Leave empty to use the account's default project.

projectId.label: Project ID (Optional)
projectId.description: Scopes inference and model listing to a specific Bedrock project (sent as the OpenAI-Project / anthropic-workspace-id header). Leave empty to use the account's default project.

roleArn.label: Assume Role ARN (Optional)
roleArn.description: Assume an IAM role before requests. Works with both explicit credentials and inherited IAM (EC2, ECS, EKS).

externalId.label: External ID (Optional)
externalId.description: Required by the role's trust policy when using cross-account access

batchRoleArn.label: Batch Role ARN (Optional)
batchRoleArn.description: Service role Bedrock assumes for batch S3 access. When set, it takes priority over the role_arn sent in requests.

vpcEndpoints.title: VPC Endpoints (Optional)
vpcEndpoints.description: Route traffic through interface VPC endpoints instead of the public regional endpoints. Use each endpoint's DNS name from the VPC console, not its ID. Region is still required — it sets the request signing scope.

controlPlane.label: Control Plane
controlPlane.description: Serves model listing and batch jobs.

s3.label: S3
s3.description: Serves batch file I/O. Requires the bucket-prefixed endpoint name. A Gateway endpoint needs no value here.

batch.label: Use for Batch APIs
batch.description: Enable this key for batch API operations. Only keys with this enabled will be used for batch requests.

table.nameExists: A deployment with this name already exists.
table.draftIncomplete: Both deployment name and model ID are required; this row will not be saved until both are filled.

overrides.sectionDescription: Override key-level {{provider}} defaults for this deployment. Leave blank to use the key's settings.
overrides.sectionDescriptionShort: Override key-level {{provider}} defaults for this deployment.

apiVersion.label: API version
apiVersion.hint: Override the Azure OpenAI api-version query parameter.

anthropicVersion.label: Anthropic version
anthropicVersion.hint: Override the anthropic-version header for Claude-on-Azure deployments.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.hint: Point this deployment at a different Azure resource than the key default.

region.label: Region
region.hint: Multi-region-only models are auto-routed to a multi-region endpoint unless Force single region is on.

forceSingleRegion.label: Force single region
forceSingleRegion.description: Call the region above as-is and skip multi-region promotion of multi-region-only models. Use for provisioned throughput.

inferenceProfileArn.label: Inference profile ARN
inferenceProfileArn.hint: Cross-region inference profile ARN to invoke instead of the model ID.

projectId.label: Project ID
projectId.hint: Scope this deployment's Bedrock Mantle (gpt-*/Gemma) calls to a specific project via the OpenAI-Project header. Leave blank to use the key's project.

projectId.label: Project ID
projectId.hint: Scope this deployment to a specific project via the OpenAI-Project / anthropic-workspace-id header. Leave blank to use the key's project.

useDeploymentsEndpoint.label: Use deployments endpoint
useDeploymentsEndpoint.hint: Route through Replicate's deployments endpoint instead of the models endpoint.

anthropicEndpoints.label: Use Anthropic endpoints
anthropicEndpoints.hint: Route chat completions and responses requests through Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

canonicalModelName.label: Canonical model name
canonicalModelName.hint: The canonical name used for routing and pricing. Defaults to the model ID when blank.

modelFamily.label: Model family
modelFamily.hint: Forces the family used for routing decisions. Derived from model name when left blank.

description.label: Description
description.hint: Note for users. Not used by Bifrost.
description.placeholder: What is this deployment used for?
